text:
Maria (Product): Heads-up — we're releasing Local Data Deletion API v1 for Private/VPC customers today at 18:00 UTC. This also enables the new customer incident reporting + ops handoff flow. TL;DR: on-prem API for tenant-scoped deletions, auditable bundles, and an ops runbook.

Devon (Eng): API is local-only, uses customer-managed auth tokens (KMS-signed). Example request: ```curl -X POST https://local-api.internal/delete -H 'Authorization: Bearer <signed_token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","resource":"session-logs"}'``` Results return a deletion_id + checksum.

Josh (SRE): Deploy plan: canary start 17:30 UTC (3 customers) -> evaluate 17:50 -> full roll 18:00 if green. I'll post metrics here.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release private-delete-1 at 2026-03-25T17:30Z.

Maria (Product): Action items: Eng - ensure audit bundles include signed timestamp + checksum; Legal - confirm language for retention & PoD; Support - update runbook & canned replies; Sales - prepare short customer blurb.

Sara (Legal): Reviewing now. We need the deletion bundle to include a verifiable checksum and a signed timestamp (for GDPR/DSAR proofs). If present, legal sign-off is quick.

Elaine (Sales): Can we get a 1-2 sentence customer blurb we can paste into replies? Prefer under 50 words. Also need a list of customers in the canary cohort to proactively contact if anything breaks.

Devon (Eng): Draft blurb: "You can request permanent deletion of tenant-scoped ephemeral data via your on-prem API. Each deletion generates an auditable bundle (deletion_id, timestamp, SHA256 checksum) for compliance verification." I'll paste the full blurb + example payload in #docs after rollout.

Josh (SRE): Canary update: 3 requests, all successful, median latency 40ms, no error spikes, logs show audit entries emitted. Proceeding to full rollout in 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated for private-delete-1 at 2026-03-25T18:05Z.

Sara (Legal): Confirmed: proof-of-deletion bundle contains SHA256, audit-log entry id, and a timestamp signed with platform key. Legal sign-off granted for GA messaging.

Alyssa (Support): I'll add the runbook to Support KB, include canned responses, and tag priority for DSAR tickets. Link me to the internal runbook when available.

Maria (Product): Runbook (internal): https://redir.company/runbooks/onprem-delete-api-v1 — Support, please copy into KB. Ops/SRE: please add the postmortem template path: /incidents/private-delete-2026-03-25 in case we need it.

Elaine (Sales): :thumbsup: I'll prepare the customer email and the list of customers to notify. Scheduling GA announcement for tomorrow 16:00 UTC after internal OK.

Josh (SRE): Follow-ups: add metric alerts for failed audit bundle generation, and a low-latency SLA check. Tag me on any incidents.

Maria (Product): Thanks everyone. If you see anything odd during the next 24h ping #eng-oncall and tag me. I'll post the formal GA announcement draft in this channel once the copy is finalized.
